# T6.01: two sessions, NVENC0 and NVENC1

`enc.c` already takes `EncConfig.engine` (channel on `NV2080_ENGINE_TYPE_NVENC0/1`, object `engineInstance`, event on
`NV2080_NOTIFIERS_NVENC0/1`).

`tools/dualenc` (two `enc.c` sessions, one thread each, 2 frames in flight, 3840x2160, 120 frames each):

| sessions | per-session time per frame |
|---|---|
| one alone on NVENC0 | 3.89 ms |
| NVENC0 + NVENC1 at once | 3.76 + 3.54 ms: **no slowdown, the engines run in parallel** |
| both on NVENC0 | 6.61 + 6.58 ms (time-shared) |

Both streams decode (h264check, 0 errors).

`libnvencvt` now places each session on the engine with fewer active sessions in the process
(`NVENCVT_ENGINE=0|1` forces one). `tools/vtdual` (two VideoToolbox sessions from two threads, 4K, 120 frames):
sessions opened on NVENC0 and NVENC1, **213 + 231 fps** at once; forced onto NVENC0, 131 + 147 fps.
